name: Collabora Online
description: Collabora Online is a self-hosted LibreOffice-based document editing server for Nextcloud Office and other WOPI clients.
short_desc: Self-hosted office document server for Nextcloud Office.
author: Collabora Productivity

form_fields.label: Collabora image
form_fields.hint: Public Docker image to run. Collabora's freely available image is CODE; if you have access to a supported Collabora Online image, put it here.

form_fields.label: Collabora public hostname
form_fields.hint: Public hostname users and WOPI clients will use for this Collabora server, without https://.

form_fields.label: Allowed WOPI host
form_fields.hint: Internal WOPI callback URL allowed to connect to Collabora. For a Runtipi Nextcloud app on the same Docker network, http://nextcloud:80 is usually correct.

form_fields.label: Admin password
form_fields.hint: Password for the Collabora admin console at /browser/dist/admin/admin.html.

form_fields.label: Extra Collabora parameters
form_fields.hint: Advanced coolwsd options. Defaults are for TLS termination at Runtipi/Tailscale.
